correctness.rationale: For every binary support the firing sets equal its cyclic translates. The exhaustive 747-orbit census uses exact dihedral canonicalization and face enumeration, only legitimate free-face collapse pairs, and integer Smith forms in every chain degree. The torsion of H_(i-1) equals the torsion of coker d_i because im d_(i-1) is a free abelian group, so nonunit Smith invariants give exact torsion. Fourteen supports have factors (2,2) in degree two; others have unit factors only. Two witnesses were also reduced from uncollapsed simplicial chains. The finite boundaries and claims agree.

value.rationale: The exact sharp finite cutoff is a natural homological boundary for a 2026-defined dynamical complex: among all 747 binary support types on cycles through fifteen vertices with chip budget five, torsion is confined to fourteen fifteen-cycle patterns, split into two integral homology signatures. A one-chip enlargement of a previously established torus produces (Z/2)^2, demonstrating a genuine integral effect invisible to rational homology. Unlike a single arbitrary numerical example, the complete small-parameter classification is motivated by the paper’s question about possible torsion and by the natural low-chip directed-cycle family.
